open.description: The controlled open state of the popover

default-open.description:
The initial open state of the popover when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the popover.

modal.description:
Whether the popover should be modal. When set to `true`:
- interaction with outside elements will be disabled
- only popover content will be visible to screen readers
- scrolling is blocked
- focus is trapped within the popover

auto-focus.description:
Whether to automatically set focus on the first focusable
content within the popover when opened.

close-on-escape.description: Whether to close the popover when the escape key is pressed.

close-on-interact-outside.description: Whether to close the popover when the user clicks outside of the popover.

placement.description: The placement of the floating element relative to its anchor.

gutter.description: The gap between the floating element and its anchor.

same-width.description: Whether the floating element matches the width of its anchor.

skip-animation-on-mount.description: Whether to allow the initial presence animation.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

openchange.description: Fired when the popover opens or closes

triggervaluechange.description: Fired when the trigger value changes.

escapekeydown.description: Fired when the escape key is pressed

requestdismiss.description: Fired when this layer is closed due to a parent layer being closed

pointerdownoutside.description: Fired when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

focusoutside.description: Fired when the focus is moved outside the component

interactoutside.description: Fired when an interaction happens outside the component

initialFocusEl.description:
The element to focus on when the popover is opened.
Return `false` to skip moving focus, or `null` to use the default.

finalFocusEl.description: Element to receive focus when the popover is closed.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the popover. Useful for composition.

translations.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

positioning.description: The user provided options used to position the popover content

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.
